sources.snippet: 8-bit builds (AWQ INT8 / FP8) stay closest to the original; 4-bit builds trade some quality for footprint — and for the sparse-MoE models the 4-bit gap is larger. ... Recommended sampling (Qwen): temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20.

sources.snippet: ⚠️ Note: this sparse-MoE model is sensitive to 4-bit quantization (+23.8% perplexity here). For production we recommend the 8-bit builds (FP8 or AWQ INT8) of this model. ... Recommended sampling (Qwen): temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20. Quantized derivative of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Apache-2.0).
